name: sfcc-storefront-analytics
description: SFCC/SFRA cartridges for native storefront analytics: validated browser beacons for product impressions, selections, views and searches, server-recorded cart and checkout steps, exactly-once order reconciliation (cancellations, refunds, late payments), and Business Manager reports with rankings, funnel and CSV export - with tests and illustrated docs.
author: Vedesh Reddy

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:isml && npm run lint:docs
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
